status_note: 3d-model-pipeline stage 7a (mini-batch 2026-10-20, wave A; editor slot 1, DS-3a 2026-10-21): UE import of the Bruce Lee look-dev run 20261021-h2-lookdev-r3 (profile bruce-lee-h2-lookdev/4: generic h2_bake H2 figure of the bake run 20261021-h2-bake-r3 + UV1 in metres, MatID, Edge, graded BC/ORM; TeamAccent ribbon on the black side stripes (wool_coarse) 7.98 % of the figure, profile bruce-lee-h2-lookdev-teamaccent-r3) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt (normaliser h2-lookdev/1) onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/BruceLee/Rig/SK_BruceLee_Skeleton. No weapon (WEAPON_HAND none, WEAPON_BONE null): 16 bones (UM_HUMANOID_17_v2 without a weapon bone), socket Weapon on hand.R (the open-hand strike, WEAPON_SOCKET_BONE of the asset card). MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (UseTeamAccent, UseUV1Metres) with the TeamAccent mask and the look-dev LUT as is (UE look-dev iteration 0); base on M_UM_BaseMarker in vertex-mask mode: two-tier Tripo stone base, the team ring by height (bake r3 textures.team_mask.base_band.height_m [0.003, 0.0285] -> vertex mask UM_Mask.R, 191 faces; VertexMaskWeight 1, SideBandWeight 0; HANDBOOK §2.9, W2-c; precedent Beowulf). Teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision 'accents + ring'). The yellow suit (linen), skin, black hair and shoes (leather_smooth) and the stone base are never dyed. At most 'technically imported'; art acceptance of the model by delegation (stage 4 r3 pass 8.8, evidence/acceptance/20261021-r3/card.json; DS-7 determinism pass, 20261021-h2-bake-r3/reports/determinism-report.json and 20261021-h2-lookdev-r3/reports/determinism-report.json). Rev 2 (UE look-dev r2, 2026-10-21, light mode by delegation, applied by ue_hero_lookdev.py apply-mi onto the run 20261021-h2ld-ue-import without re-import): LUT T_UM_MatLUT_BruceLee_UE_r2 (leather_smooth specular 0.5 -> 0.2, roughness 0.5 [0.45, 0.56]; skin cavityTintStrength 0.35 -> 0.2) and MI knobs: hero Saturation 0.98 (linen over-saturated: sat +0.098 board / +0.144 reading), AN-32 Fix slot A on MatID class 13 skin FixGainA 1.2 (skin Y 0.81x / 0.66x the linen-anchored concept). Reason: review r1 black hair and shoes (leather_smooth) Y 4.10x / 2.89x - the hair reads silver-grey (sky reflection of specular 0.5 over the near-floor bake).
